filters.description:
JSON specifying filter conditions.
Accepts the same format as returned by the [queries](https://www.openproject.org/docs/api/endpoints/queries/) endpoint.
Currently supported filters are:

- name: filters placeholder users by the name.
- group: filters placeholder by the group it is contained in.
- status: filters placeholder by the status it has. (operations: list_placeholder_users, list)

select.description: Comma separated list of properties to include. (operations: list_placeholder_users, list)

name.description: The new name of the placeholder user to be created. (operations: create_placeholder_user, update_placeholder_user)

id.description: Placeholder user id — integer (numeric string ok) (operations: delete_placeholder_user, get_placeholder_user, update_placeholder_user)

confirmed.description: Optional. Two-Phase write confirm: set confirmed=true (or ja/yes/1) to execute POST/PATCH/PUT/DELETE. Without it, mutating calls return a confirmation ask.
